parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Indicates whether or not the power sensor is enabled.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of this power sensor.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Name of this power sensor. This text MUST be sufficient to distinguish this power sensor from other power sensors.

parameters.name: LastUpdate
parameters.description: The time at which this power sensor's last good reading was obtained. The Unknown Time value, as defined in {{bibref|TR-106}}, indicates a good reading has not been obtained since last reset.

parameters.name: Voltage
parameters.description: The voltage measured by the sensor, in {{units}}.

parameters.name: Current
parameters.description: The current measured by the sensor, in {{units}}.

parameters.name: Power
parameters.description: The power measured by the sensor, in {{units}}.

object.description: Represents the power sensor parameters including voltage, current, and power measurements.
